sequence: Remove phone and release twine tension.
Fully remove the rail nut toward +X, then withdraw the screw toward -X.
Pull complete module +X 4.5 mm to disengage the locating lugs.
Lower module 2 mm along -Z, then continue withdrawal toward +X.
Off tool, remove keeper band, slide cross-key -Z, then pull axle -Y. Reverse for assembly.
limits: Sampled rigid clearance only. Nut rotation uses a cylindrical envelope; thread engagement excluded.
Human access, handling, friction, print tolerance and band retention need physical tests.
